For one computer science student, it led to a career path they hadn't fully discovered yet. As a Business Intelligence intern at our Corporate Office in Saskatoon, they gained experience with real-world data projects, from Power BI and data warehousing to AI initiatives. Along the way, supportive teammates helped them build technical skills, confidence and a deeper understanding of how data helps drive business decisions. What started as a student opportunity became a clearer vision for the future and a return to Cameco as a junior analyst. Where could a work term at Cameco take you?
